## Slabbed 0.6.6-alpha+26.2-26.3

For Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3 on Fabric. Requires Fabric API and Java 25.

### FIXED

- Lowered blocks keep their drawn height when Fusion replaces or appends block models. Thanks to lilonkish ([#112](https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues/112)) and EnormeKartoffel ([#116](https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues/116)) for the reports. Tested with Fusion 1.3.16 on Minecraft 26.2 using a focused resource pack; the reporters' exact packs remain unverified. This does not advertise Fusion support on 26.3, for which no official compatible Fusion build was available.
- Blocks animated by Stupid Block Animations now start at their stored height and rotate around the correct lowered position, avoiding the half-block snap when the animation finishes. Thanks to bluegamer1166 ([#115](https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues/115)). Tested with Stupid Block Animations 0.1.3 on both game versions.
- The F3 Targeted Block and block-tag readouts follow the lowered block under the crosshair. Thanks to NSSCaptain for the original report on the Fabric 1.20.1 line ([#100](https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues/100)). The fluid readout is unchanged; this does not change Jade on this game line.

## Slabbed 0.6.8-alpha+1.20.1

For Minecraft 1.20.1 on Fabric. Requires Fabric Loader 0.16 or newer, Fabric API 0.92.x, and Java 17 or newer.

### FIXED

- Jade now identifies a lowered slab when aiming at its side, including when another block is behind it. Nearer fluids, entities and ordinary blocks still take priority. Thanks to NSSCaptain ([#100](https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues/100)). Tested with Jade 11.13.3; Jade remains optional. The F3 correction from 0.6.3-alpha is retained.

## Slabbed 0.6.7-alpha+1.21.1

For Minecraft 1.21.1 on NeoForge 21.1.233 or newer. Requires Java 21.

### FIXED

- The F3 Targeted Block readout follows the lowered block under the crosshair. Thanks to NSSCaptain for the original report on another game line ([#100](https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues/100)). Fluid targeting and Jade are unchanged.

### IMPROVED

- Reduce repeated height lookups while building block models: the same block's height is reused across seam checks, and ordinary terrain uses chunk-level absence checks for stored heights and anchors. Thanks to sewzrat ([#92](https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues/92)) and ALEILGOD ([#87](https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues/87)) for the redraw-lag reports. The new reuse step reduced CPU time by about 38% in a focused model benchmark against the preceding local implementation; this is not an overall FPS or modpack performance claim.
- Keep processing other block models when one foreign model rejects an eager query during model baking, and avoid querying wrappers owned by another renderer. Thanks to caohuuminhtrung ([#108](https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues/108)) for the crash report. This hardening is tested, but the report's exact crash still needs its stack trace and is not confirmed resolved.

## Slabbed 0.6.3-alpha+1.20.1 — F3 targeted block fix

For Minecraft 1.20.1 on Fabric (Quilt works too). Requires Fabric API 0.92.x and Java 17 or newer.

- The F3 debug screen's "Targeted Block" readout now names the lowered block you're looking at. The debug screen does its own targeting, separate from the crosshair, and it walked the normal block grid, so looking at the side of a slab placed on a slab reported the block space below it. The readout now uses the same lowered-block-aware targeting as the crosshair. Thanks to NSSCaptain for reporting this with screenshots (GitHub issue #100).

Jade and other mods that do their own targeting aren't changed by this yet.

## Slabbed 0.6.2-alpha+1.21.1-fabric — ScalableLux world-loading fix

For Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric. Requires Fabric API and Java 21.

- Fixed an existing world hanging on the loading screen when ScalableLux is installed. One of ScalableLux's background lighting threads could end up waiting on Slabbed for a chunk that the server itself was still loading, and the two waited on each other forever. Slabbed now answers those background threads with the plain vanilla block shape and never makes them wait on a chunk. Thanks to Kloytz for reporting this and for the careful with-and-without testing that narrowed it down (GitHub issue #78).

I haven't run the exact modpack from the report, so if that old world still won't load on this build, please tell me on the issue and I'll keep digging.

## Slabbed 0.6.2-alpha for Minecraft 26.1.2 (Fabric) — Refresh to the 0.6.1 feature set

This is a one-time refresh of the Minecraft 26.1.2 build. The last public 26.1 file was `0.4.2-beta.2`; this release brings 26.1.2 up to the same behaviour as `0.6.1-alpha` on 26.2, with no new features beyond that. The 26.1.2 line is frozen after this release unless demand returns.

- Everything listed under `0.6.1-alpha+26.2` and the earlier 0.5.x / 0.6.0 releases now applies on 26.1.2: lowered fence posts, rails and redstone on lowered slabs, remembered heights through material swaps and block replacements, deep side placement, hanging decorations that keep their seat and never stall a chunk load, farmland and path handling, and the Terrain Slabs, Sodium and
 Lithium compatibility work.
- Beds placed on lowered supports settle at the right height straight away on your screen. On 26.1.2 the game itself only adds the second half of a bed on the server, so Slabbed now adds it on the client too, the way 26.2 does; without that the bed flashed at full height until the server replied.
- Sulfur spikes do not exist on 26.1.2, so that part of the stored-height coverage is absent here.
- Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer and Fabric API 0.155.3+26.1.2 or newer.

For Minecraft 26.1.2 with Fabric (Fabric API 0.155.3+26.1.2 or newer, Java 25).

This is an alpha. If anything misbehaves, please open a report at https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues with your game version, loader and Slabbed version.

## Slabbed 0.6.2-alpha+1.21.9-1.21.11 — One file for Minecraft 1.21.9, 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 (Fabric)

One file now covers Minecraft 1.21.9, 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 on Fabric. Behaviour is unchanged from 0.6.1-alpha; this release is about running the same build on three game versions.

- Minecraft 1.21.9 and 1.21.10 are now supported. The crosshair pick, the Lithium collision seam and the `/slabdev` permission check differ between those versions and 1.21.11, and the build chooses the right one when the game starts.
- On 1.21.9 and 1.21.10, Sodium 0.7 (proven with 0.7.3) keeps exposed height-step faces visible, matching the Sodium 0.8 behaviour on 1.21.11.
- Known gaps on 1.21.9 and 1.21.10: Better Block Entities 1.2.0 has a different structure and is not yet aligned with lowered placements; Countered's Terrain Slabs has no build for these two versions, so that compatibility is untested there.
- Requires Fabric Loader 0.16 or newer and Fabric API 0.134.1 or newer.

For Minecraft 1.21.9, 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 with Fabric (Fabric API 0.134.1 or newer, Java 21).

This is an alpha. If anything misbehaves, please open a report at https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues with your game version, loader and Slabbed version.

## Slabbed 0.6.2-alpha+1.21.6-1.21.8 — One file for Minecraft 1.21.6, 1.21.7 and 1.21.8 (Fabric)

One file covers Minecraft 1.21.6, 1.21.7 and 1.21.8 on Fabric. This is the first Slabbed release for these three versions; the behaviour is the 0.6.1-alpha feature set as shipped for 1.21.9 and newer.

- Everything Slabbed does on 1.21.9–1.21.11 now applies here: placed blocks keep the height they were placed at, with targeting, outlines, collision, models, particles, block entities, hanging decorations, rails and redstone following that height.
- Sodium 0.6 and 0.7 keep exposed height-step faces visible; Lithium 0.17 and 0.18 collide with lowered blocks where they are drawn; Better Block Entities 1.0–1.2 draws its chests, shulker boxes, bells and pots at the lowered height.
- Copper chains do not exist on these versions, so the chain support work covers iron chains only.
- Requires Fabric Loader 0.16 or newer and Fabric API 0.128 or newer (0.128.2 on 1.21.6, 0.129 on 1.21.7, 0.136 on 1.21.8 are the builds this release was proven with).

For Minecraft 1.21.6, 1.21.7 and 1.21.8 with Fabric (Fabric API 0.128 or newer, Java 21).

This is an alpha. If anything misbehaves, please open a report at https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues with your game version, loader and Slabbed version.

## Slabbed 0.6.2-alpha+1.21.5 — First Fabric build for Minecraft 1.21.5

The first Slabbed build for Minecraft 1.21.5 on Fabric, with the same behaviour as the 1.21.6–1.21.8 file.

- Everything Slabbed does on 1.21.6 and newer now applies on 1.21.5: placed blocks keep the height they were placed at, with targeting, outlines, collision, models, particles, block entities, hanging decorations, rails and redstone following that height.
- Item frames and paintings remember their seat the same way; on 1.21.5 the remembered seat is stored per decoration type because the game keeps their synced data separate here. Saved worlds use the same key as every other version.
- Better Block Entities and Create Fly have no 1.21.5 builds, so those compatibility hooks stay idle; Sodium 0.6 and Lithium 0.16 are supported in principle but were not exercised live for this build.
- Requires Fabric Loader 0.16 or newer and Fabric API 0.128 or newer.

For Minecraft 1.21.5 with Fabric (Fabric API 0.128 or newer, Java 21).

This is an alpha. If anything misbehaves, please open a report at https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues with your game version, loader and Slabbed version.

## Slabbed 0.6.2-alpha+1.21.4-fabric — First Fabric build for Minecraft 1.21.4

First Slabbed build for Minecraft 1.21.4 (part of the promised 1.21.2–1.21.10 range). It carries the full feature set of the 1.21.1 line: placement heights are recorded where you aim and kept for good, lowered slabs support the same objects, rails slope to meet their neighbours, fence posts meet a nearby slab ceiling, hung decorations keep their seat.

Needs Fabric API 0.119.4 or newer (the renderer API this build draws lowered blocks through).

- Pale moss carpet, new in 1.21.4, follows the same rules as the other carpets on lowered slabs.
- The Minecart Improvements experiment is not covered: with it enabled, carts ride at vanilla height over lowered rails. Item frames keep the 1.21.1 line's behaviour (no render drop for frames without a remembered seat).
- The 1.21.2 game refactors (block neighbour updates carry a wire orientation, minecart movement moved to a controller, redstone wire power moved to a controller, entity renderers work from render states, world events moved to their own handler) are followed where Slabbed hooks them; behaviour is unchanged.

For Minecraft 1.21.4 with Fabric (Fabric API 0.119.4 or newer, Java 21).

This is an alpha. If anything misbehaves, please open a report at https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues with your game version, loader and Slabbed version.

## Slabbed 0.6.2-alpha+1.21.2-1.21.3 — One file for Minecraft 1.21.2 and 1.21.3 (Fabric)

First Slabbed build for Minecraft 1.21.2 and 1.21.3, one file for both (1.21.3 is a two-fix hotfix of 1.21.2; part of the promised 1.21.2–1.21.10 range). It carries the full feature set of the 1.21.1 line: placement heights are recorded where you aim and kept for good, lowered slabs support the same objects, rails slope to meet their neighbours, fence posts meet a nearby slab ceiling, hung decorations keep their seat.

Needs Fabric API 0.114.1 or newer.

- The 1.21.2 game refactors (block neighbour updates carry a wire orientation, minecart movement moved to a controller, redstone wire power moved to a controller, entity renderers work from render states, world events moved to their own handler) are followed where Slabbed hooks them; behaviour is unchanged.
- The experimental pale moss carpet, where enabled, follows the same rules as the other carpets on lowered slabs.
- The Minecart Improvements experiment is not covered: with it enabled, carts ride at vanilla height over lowered rails. Item frames keep the 1.21.1 line's behaviour (no render drop for frames without a remembered seat).

For Minecraft 1.21.2 and 1.21.3 with Fabric (Fabric API 0.114.1 or newer, Java 21).

This is an alpha. If anything misbehaves, please open a report at https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues with your game version, loader and Slabbed version.

## Slabbed 0.6.2-alpha+1.20.3-1.20.4 — One file for Minecraft 1.20.3 and 1.20.4 (Fabric)

One file for Minecraft 1.20.3 and 1.20.4 (Fabric). It carries the full 0.6.1 feature set of the Fabric 1.21.1 line: placement heights are recorded where you aim and kept for good, lowered slabs support the same objects, rails slope to meet their neighbours, fence posts meet a nearby slab ceiling, hung decorations keep their seat.

Needs Fabric API 0.96 or newer (the 1.20.4 builds also run on 1.20.3) and Fabric Loader 0.16 or newer, on Java 17 or newer.

Differences on these versions:

- Placement heights reach other players through Slabbed's own chunk sync message, because these versions' Fabric API cannot sync chunk data on its own. Heights arrive with the chunk and after every change.
- Creative-mode placements record their height like survival ones (these versions skip the "use up the item" step for creative players; the height is recorded at the block-place event instead).
- The decorated-pot insert particle follows the pot's stored height again (the particle exists here).
- Bone-meal sparkles on a lowered block are not yet moved down with the block (the particle helper Slabbed hooks for that does not exist on these versions).

For Minecraft 1.20.3 and 1.20.4 with Fabric (Fabric API 0.96 or newer, Java 17 or newer).

This is an alpha. If anything misbehaves, please open a report at https://github.com/peetsamods/slabbed/issues with your game version, loader and Slabbed version.
